summary: STILL_REPRODUCES from mncs-engine: reported `steps` is backend-local with no per-backend unit (Cranelift reports steps=1 for work the reference backend counts in six digits), so cross-backend performance claims cannot use `steps`; heavy corpora additionally exceed orchestration budgets (scene-scene >280s reference, ~hour-scale Cranelift cells).
